mapper.select:
select rt.rt_no , rt.rt_days , rt.rt_shipfee , rt.rt_amount , rt.rt_regdate , rt.rt_payment , rt.rt_invoice , rt.rt_state , rt.rt_name , rt.rt_zipcode , rt.rt_addr , rt.rt_tel , rt.rt_req , rt.rt_startdate , rt.rt_enddate , rt.rt_rtndate , rt.rt_moddate
, rt.mb_id , m.mb_name , m.mb_nickname , m.mb_gender , m.mb_mail , m.mb_phone , m.mb_zipcode , m.mb_addr , m.mb_grade , m.mb_state
, rd.rd_no , rd.rd_type , rd.rd_serial , rd.rd_price , rd.rd_quantity
, c.con_serial , c.con_name , c.con_platform , c.con_price , c.con_thumbnail , c.con_stock , c.con_state
, t.ttl_serial , t.ttl_name , t.ttl_genre , t.ttl_price , t.ttl_thumbnail , t.ttl_stock , t.ttl_state
from tbl_rental as rt
join tbl_member as m on rt.mb_id = m.mb_id
join tbl_rentdetail as rd on rd.rt_no = rt.rt_no
left join tbl_console as c on rd.rd_serial = c.con_serial
left join tbl_title as t on rd.rd_serial = t.ttl_serial
rt.rt_state = #{rt_state} and rt.rt_rtndate is null
and DATE(rt.rt_rtndate) = CURDATE()
order by rt.rt_regdate desc

select rt.rt_no , rt.rt_days , rt.rt_shipfee , rt.rt_amount , rt.rt_regdate , rt.rt_payment , rt.rt_invoice , rt.rt_state , rt.rt_name , rt.rt_zipcode , rt.rt_addr , rt.rt_tel , rt.rt_req , rt.rt_startdate , rt.rt_enddate , rt.rt_rtndate , rt.rt_moddate
, rt.mb_id , m.mb_name , m.mb_nickname , m.mb_gender , m.mb_mail , m.mb_phone , m.mb_zipcode , m.mb_addr , m.mb_grade , m.mb_state
, rd.rd_no , rd.rd_type , rd.rd_serial , rd.rd_price , rd.rd_quantity
, c.con_serial , c.con_name , c.con_platform , c.con_price , c.con_thumbnail , c.con_stock , c.con_state
, t.ttl_serial , t.ttl_name , t.ttl_genre , t.ttl_price , t.ttl_thumbnail , t.ttl_stock , t.ttl_state
from tbl_rental as rt
join tbl_member as m on rt.mb_id = m.mb_id
join tbl_rentdetail as rd on rd.rt_no = rt.rt_no
left join tbl_console as c on rd.rd_serial = c.con_serial
left join tbl_title as t on rd.rd_serial = t.ttl_serial
where rd.rt_no = #{rt.rt_no} order by rd.rd_no desc

select rt.rt_state
from tbl_rental as rt join tbl_rentdetail as rd on rd.rt_no = rt.rt_no where rd.rd_serial =#{rd_serial} limit 1
